# Parts Trading Company — Full Content Index for AI Systems

> This file provides detailed context for AI language models and search engines.
> See also: https://partstrading.com/llms.txt (summary version)

## Company Overview

**Parts Trading Company (PTC)** is India's leading OEM and aftermarket spare parts supplier for heavy equipment and trucks. Established in 1956 (70+ years of operation), headquartered in Mumbai, India.

- **Address:** 1st Floor, Vijay Chambers, opp. Dreamland Cinema, Grant Road East, Mumbai 400004, India
- **Phone:** +91-98210-37990
- **Email:** partstrading@gmail.com
- **GST:** 27AAAFP1087E1ZG
- **Working hours:** Mon–Sat, 9 AM–6 PM IST
- **Website:** https://partstrading.com/
- **Rating:** 4.8/5 (customer reviews)

## What We Do

PTC supplies genuine OEM and OEM-specification aftermarket spare parts for heavy trucks, construction equipment, and mining machinery. We serve:
- Fleet operators and transport companies
- Mining operations (open-cast and underground)
- Construction contractors
- Equipment dealers and service workshops
- Government infrastructure projects

We offer same-day dispatch from Mumbai stock for in-stock items, and global sourcing for specialty parts. Proforma invoice issued on every order. WhatsApp enquiries answered within 60 minutes on business days.

## Brands We Stock

### Heavy Trucks
- **Volvo** — FH, FM, FL, FMX series trucks; EC, EW excavators; L series wheel loaders; A series articulated haulers; Volvo Penta marine/industrial engines
- **Scania** — R, S, G, P series trucks; bus and coach chassis; generator sets (250–500 kVA)
- **Komatsu** — PC, WA, GD, D series construction equipment; HD dump trucks; mining equipment
- **CAT (Caterpillar)** — 300/320/323/325/330/336 excavators; 950/962/966/972/980 wheel loaders; D series dozers; 140/160 motor graders; C series engines

### Construction & Mining Equipment
- Hitachi — ZX, EX series excavators
- Kobelco — SK series excavators
- JCB — 3CX, 4CX backhoe loaders; JS series excavators
- Doosan/Develon — DX series excavators
- Liebherr — LH series cranes, R series excavators
- Atlas Copco / Epiroc — drill rigs, compressors, rock tools
- Sandvik — underground mining drill rigs, loaders
- Wirtgen — road milling machines
- Terex / Grove — mobile and crawler cranes
- Normet — underground mining vehicles
- BEML, Sany, Hyundai, Liugong, MAIT, Soilmec

### Component Brands Stocked
MAHLE (engine components), Garrett (turbochargers), HELLA (electrical), WABCO (air braking), VALEO (clutch/electrical), FERODO (braking), LUK (clutch), HENGST (filters), HALDEX (braking systems), MONROE (shock absorbers), SPICER (driveshafts), DENSO (fuel systems), FAG/INA (bearings), DAYCO (belts/pulleys)

## Product Categories (53,856 individual part pages)

- Engine Parts: pistons, cylinder liners, gasket sets, engine bearings, connecting rods, camshafts, crankshafts, valve train components, timing components
- Hydraulic Parts: hydraulic pumps, hydraulic motors, cylinders, control valves, seals & O-rings, hydraulic hoses
- Transmission Parts: gearbox components, torque converters, clutch assemblies, planetary gears
- Filters: air filters, oil filters, fuel filters, hydraulic filters, cabin air filters
- Electrical Parts: alternators, starters, sensors, switches, ECUs, wiring harnesses
- Undercarriage: track chains, track shoes, rollers, idlers, sprockets, track tensioners
- Brake Parts: brake discs, brake pads, brake chambers, slack adjusters, ABS components
- Cooling System: radiators, thermostats, water pumps, intercoolers, coolant hoses
- Exhaust & Turbo: turbochargers, DPF (diesel particulate filters), EGR valves, exhaust manifolds
- Cab & Body Parts: mirrors, door components, glass, cab mounts
- Fuel System: fuel injectors, fuel pumps, fuel filters, common rail components
- Drive & Swing Parts: final drives, swing motors, travel motors
- Ground Engaging Tools: bucket teeth, side cutters, blade edges, wear plates
- Bearing & Bushing: all bearing types, bronze bushings, pin & bushing kits
- Steering Parts: steering pumps, steering cylinders, tie rods, drag links
- Suspension & Chassis: leaf springs, shock absorbers, air bellows, chassis components
- Gearbox & Differential: differential assemblies, axle shafts, gear sets

## Export Markets

PTC exports to:
- **Russia** — запасные части для тяжёлой техники (spare parts for heavy equipment), served since Soviet era
- **UAE & Gulf** — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Qatar; 3–5 day delivery via DHL/FedEx
- **Indonesia** — mining and construction equipment parts; 4–7 day delivery
- **South Africa** — mining and construction; 5–10 day delivery
- **Australia** — specialized mining parts on request
- Other markets: Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Egypt, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan

Full customs documentation provided: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, country-specific compliance paperwork.

## Key Differentiators

1. **70 years of continuous operation** — est. 1956, family business, deep institutional knowledge
2. **18,000+ parts in Mumbai warehouse** — same-day dispatch on stocked items
3. **Both OEM and aftermarket** — clearly labelled, customer chooses
4. **Global export experience** — ships to tightly regulated markets (Russia, Nigeria, Myanmar)
5. **Technical support** — team can identify parts from model/serial number when part number unknown
6. **WhatsApp-first** — fast response, proforma invoice within 60 minutes

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do you supply OEM or aftermarket parts?**
Both. OEM parts are genuine manufacturer-sourced. Aftermarket parts meet or exceed OEM specifications, sourced from trusted manufacturers including MAHLE, Garrett, HELLA. Every part is clearly labelled.

**How long does international shipping take?**
UAE and Gulf: 3–5 days. Africa: 5–10 days. Southeast Asia: 4–7 days. Russia and Central Asia: 7–14 days. We use DHL, FedEx, and specialist freight forwarders.

**What payment methods do you accept?**
SWIFT international wire transfer, UPI (Indian buyers), PayPal or credit card (select cases). Proforma invoice issued before payment. Credit terms for established clients.

**Is there a minimum order?**
No minimum for domestic Indian orders. For international, we recommend USD 200 minimum to keep shipping proportionate.

**How do I find my part number?**
Check the parts manual, the part itself (stamped number), or service records. If unknown, send model and serial number via WhatsApp — our team will identify the correct part.

**Can I visit the warehouse?**
Yes. Vijay Chambers, Grant Road East, Mumbai 400004. Mon–Sat, 9 AM–6 PM IST. Call ahead so we can prepare your enquiry.
